name: Fuzzy Join
description: Joins two tables on similar text keys. Similarity is computed by DuckDB: jaro_winkler_similarity, levenshtein or damerau_levenshtein normalised by the longer key length. Candidates below 'threshold' are dropped, the best 'max_matches' right rows per left row are kept, and 'how' decides whether unmatched left rows survive. The output is the joined table plus a 'similarity' column; a right column whose name clashes gets the 'suffix'.

left_key.title: Left key
left_key.description: Text column of the left input.

right_key.title: Right key
right_key.description: Text column of the right input.

method.title: Similarity method
method.description: String similarity used to match the keys.

how.title: Join type
how.description: inner keeps matched rows only, left keeps every left row.

max_matches.title: Max matches
max_matches.description: How many right rows one left row may match.

suffix.title: Right column suffix
suffix.description: Suffix for a right column whose name already exists.
